text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――I wonder what "love" really is.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"We were born without knowing that answer, 
and we keep on living..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Surely at this very moment, somewhere 
in the world, someone is—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Searching for “love.”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Seeking... “love.”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...What "love" means to me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: What that actually was.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Will you... listen to me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
âThe first day of taking on the Twinkle 
Series with Loves Only You.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Love me♡ Love you♡ It's Loves Only You~♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone~♪ Are 
you getting enough Love today~?

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Got plenty of Love~!" "Love at full 
throttle!" "Hello!" "We've been waiting!" 
"Love-plenty~" "Good work~"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone's so excited. Today, I have 
an important announcement for all of you♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And what might that be~? Trainer-kun, if 
you would please do the honors!
choice_data_list:
—Loves, congratulations on setting your 
debut race!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And what might that be~? Trainer-chan, if 
you would please do the honors!
choice_data_list:
—Loves, congratulations on setting your 
debut race!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yay! And so, my debut race date is 
officially set~♡

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Oooooh!" "Congratulations!" "Debut race 
is here!!" "Let's goooo!!" "It's a 
festival!" "Happy days!" "888888"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ This is all thanks to everyone's 
support♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
There are still plenty of days left until 
my debut race, so until then, look forward 
to seeing me grow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...With her full-scale debut underway, 
Loves Only You is hosting a stream to give 
an update to her fan community.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as her trainer in charge, until not 
too long ago I was just one of the 
"commu-members," cheering her on through a 
screen, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—To protect the bond between her and the 
community members, and to safeguard our 
future, I resolved to support her as her 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I'm still nervous. After 
all, the burning hopes of so many circle 
members rest upon my shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Ah, Trainer-kun! Look, look!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Ah, Trainer-chan! Look, look!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Look! Trainer-kun, everyone is sending in 
comments for you♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Look! Trainer-chan, everyone is sending in 
comments for you♪

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"You got this too, Bridge!" "We're rooting 
for you!" "Nice to meet you, our Trainer!" 
"Please take good care of Loves~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the stream's chat, messages of 
encouragement from the community members 
toward her were lining up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though each member of the community 
expressed it differently, each and every 
word felt imbued with the same heartfelt 
warmth—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ You're all fired up now, aren't you, 
Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, starting fresh today, I'll give it 
my all...!

Yeah, I'll start giving it my all again 
today...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ You're all fired up now, aren't you, 
Trainer-chan?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, starting fresh today, I'll give it 
my all...!

Yeah, I'll start giving it my all again 
today...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, the stream reporting my debut 
race to the commu-members ended with me 
receiving courage from them in return—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ââHah!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Phew... Yeah, looking good♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how was that? I feel like my pacing 
just now was spot on!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, you're practically right on the 
target time.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yay~! I had a good feeling about that~♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but—when I was focusing on pacing, my 
cornering felt a bit sloppy. I'll need to 
fix that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Training with Loves Only You has been 
going smoothly right from day one."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her mind works quickly, and she always 
thinks things through thoroughly as she 
acts. Because of that, she's fast to 
identify her own areas for improvement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Combined with her naturally immense 
talent, having her as my trainee was truly 
reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Okay♪ Then starting next time, I'll keep 
what you just told me in mind♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All right...! I'm gonna keep giving it my 
all so I have good news for the fan club 
tonight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Loves Only You continued to 
train with high motivation—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —That night.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"—And that's pretty much it! I worked up a 
reaaally good sweat today♪"

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Good work~" "So fired up~" "Things get 
intense once the debut is set." 
"Impressive right from day one!" "That's 
Tracen Academy for you."

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Now that Loves-chan's debut is set, she's 
gotten even more lovely! It's so fun just 
watching her!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~!? I had so much fun too! 
That's why I wanted to share it right 
away~. All this exciting love♡

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Praise be~" "Yes, sending love!" "You 
look so happy, it makes me happy too!" "I 
can feel the fun vibe!" "Like!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—Food? Of course I've already eaten. 
...How many bowls did I have? Huh~? That's 
a bit embarrassing, so it's a secret♪”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I watched Loves Only You's stream 
recapping today's events through the 
screen, just like any other community 
member.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her talk so happily, I felt a 
small sense of accomplishment that the 
training had gone well, when—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"My goal after the Debut Race? Hmm, well, 
let's see...—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, "Bridge-san." You're watching 
right now, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I let out a gasp before I could stop 
myself. "Bridge" was my screen name within 
Loves Only You's community.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"May I take this moment to tell 
everyone... and you, once again?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"May I take this moment to tell 
everyone... and you, once again?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "My goal. ...My dream."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...You know, I really, truly love 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
When I first fell in love with racing as a 
little girl, Mom and Dad made this place 
so a whole crowd of people could watch 
over me—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That was the beginning of this community, 
and how we all met, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's pure feelings of support have 
always given me the courage to take on new 
challenges.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I failed, whenever it was tough, 
everyone's encouragement got me back on my 
feet—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It was because of my bond with everyone 
that I was able to hone my running enough 
to make it into Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to everyone's love, I was able to 
advance far enough to make my debut...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I want to prove it. With my most lovely 
self, victorious on the grand stage—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Just how wonderful the bond—the 
love—between me and my community is!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I'll spread it across all of Japan―― No, 
across the entire world……!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"And so the whole world will be united in 
a strong bond like ours, sharing love—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—Just kidding. Hehe♪ Is that a bit too 
grand? But that's the dream I want to 
fulfill someday ♡”

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"So cool!" "Don't make me cry~" "So 
emotional!" "Cheering for you!" "That's 
big love right there!" "So typical of 
Loves-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Everyone—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you♪ I'm so glad to have all of 
you in my community♡
choice_data_list:
"I will definitely take you to the world 
stage."

"I will definitely take you to the world 
stage."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
choice_data_list:
"I will be the bridge that connects you to 
the world."

"To become the bridge that connects you to 
the world."

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Well said!" "Nice one!" "Love it!" "So 
classy~" "HYPED" "👏👏👏👏👏👏" "Way to 
go, Ms. Bridge-Builder!" "Amazing!!"

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there, our bridge! If anything 
comes up, you can count on us too!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for such wonderful words. 
They really warmed my heart♪ So—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to working with you again 
tomorrow, Trainer-kun!♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to working with you again 
tomorrow, Trainer-chan!♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so began the days of taking on 
challenges with Loves Only You!
